title: 第十一章 柠柠的惊喜现身
slug: 什么网恋的清冷校花竟是双胞胎
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

班会结束后，教学楼挤满了拎着军训服的大一新生，三三两两的凑在一起说说笑笑。

郭子峰走在最前面，时不时地跟旁边的李东吐槽一下。

“我靠了，人咋这么多？”

身后的陈舟没理会他们，一直低着头跟柠柠聊天。。

柠柠:【等你军训完，你肯定都晒成黑煤球了！】

柠柠：【你要变成黑煤球，我就不喜欢你了哦，我就要去找别的小男宝了，嘿嘿。】

陈舟当然知道她是在开玩笑，一阵傻笑。。

陈舟：【那我走啦！】

陈舟：【白色小熊逃跑.jpg】

正当他聊得兴起的时候，走在前面的郭子峰开始耍宝了，抖了抖军训服，语气里满是自恋。

“东子，接下来的两周，我的颜值要被这身军训服封印了。”

旁边的路灿嗤笑一声走上前去拍了拍郭子峰的肩膀。

“峰哥，这是好事啊，拉平了你跟别人的颜值！”

前面的郭子峰话匣子一下子就

“哎，路灿啊，我看网上说，如果大一没谈过恋爱，那大学会单身四年的。”

路灿一脸无所谓，撇了撇嘴。

“不谈就不谈呗，女人只会影响我上分的速度，我们go学长不需要女人，你这个瓦学弟太压抑了。”

郭子峰憨憨的笑了一下，没接路灿的话转而走到一直低着头没说话的陈舟旁边，脸上堆着笑，讨好地说了一句。

“义父，你作为咱们宿舍的颜值担当，班上女生找你联谊你可一定要答应啊，兄弟大学四年的幸福生活可全在你身上了！”

陈舟刚收起手机，一想到刚刚柠柠说的让他离女孩子远点，他也只好委婉的拒绝了郭子峰。

“我真有女朋友了，别的宿舍找我我不去的话应该不好吧？”

郭子峰震惊地看着他。

“我去，你下手这么快？刚刚和咱们班加你的那个女生谈上了？”

“靠，我要去整容了。”郭子峰拿着手机，张脸整。”

陈舟脸上露出无奈，暗道，自己看上去是那么压抑的人？刚跟班上女生认识就谈恋爱？

为了自己的名誉着想，陈舟还是打算澄清一下。

“不是啊，我跟你说了，是迎新的那个学姐。”

一听到陈舟这么说，其余俩人也围了上来。

“不是，哥们，逗我玩呢，那学姐像是喜欢人类的人吗。”

郭子峰说。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After the class meeting, the teaching building was crowded with freshmen carrying military training uniforms, gathering in twos and threes to talk and laugh.

Guo Zifeng walked at the front, complaining to Li Dong next to him from time to time.

"Damn it, why are there so many people?"

Behind him, Chen Zhou ignored them and kept chatting with Ning Ning with his head down..

Ning Ning: [By the time you finish your military training, you will definitely be tanned and brittle!】

Ning Ning: [If you turn into a black coal ball, I won’t like you. I’m going to find another little boy, hehe.】

Of course Chen Zhou knew she was joking and giggled..

Chen Zhou: [Then I’m leaving!】

Chen Zhou: [White bear escapes.jpg]

Just when he was getting excited about chatting, Guo Zifeng, who was walking in front, started to show off, shaking his military training uniform, and his tone was full of narcissism.

"Dongzi, in the next two weeks, my appearance will be sealed by this military training uniform."

Lu Can, who was next to him, sneered and stepped forward to pat Guo Zifeng on the shoulder.

"Brother Feng, this is a good thing. It equalizes your appearance with others!"

The chatterbox of Guo Zifeng in front suddenly started

"Hey, Lu Can, I read on the Internet that if you don't fall in love in your freshman year, you will be single for four years."

Lu Can looked indifferent and curled his lips.

"If you don't want to talk about it, don't talk about it. Women will only affect the speed of my score improvement. We, Senior Go, don't need women. You, Junior Wa, are too repressed."

Guo Zifeng smiled naively, and instead of answering Lu Can's words, he walked to Chen Zhou who had lowered his head and said nothing. With a smile on his face, he said something flattering.

"Father, as you are in charge of the beauty of our dormitory, you must agree to the girls in the class who ask you to socialize. My brother's four-year happy life in college depends entirely on you!"

Chen Zhou just put away his phone, and when he thought about Ning Ning's words to him to stay away from girls, he had no choice but to politely reject Guo Zifeng.

"I really have a girlfriend. It shouldn't be bad if I don't go to other dormitories, right?"

Guo Zifeng looked at him in shock.

"I'll go, you started so quickly? Did you just talk to the girl who joined you in our class?"

"Damn, I'm going to have plastic surgery." Guo Zifeng held his phone and opened his face."

Chen Zhou had helplessness on his face and thought to himself, does he seem to be such a depressed person?Falling in love with a girl in class just after meeting her?

For the sake of his own reputation, Chen Zhou decided to clarify.

"No, I told you, it's the senior who welcomes new students."

As soon as Chen Zhou said this, the other two people also gathered around.

"No, buddy, you are teasing me. Does that senior sister seem to like human beings?"

Guo Zifeng said.
